record.question: What is the mechanism of action of fluoroquinolones?
options: They inhibit bacterial cell wall synthesis
They Cause leakage from bacterial cell membrane
record.explanation: Answer A: They inhibit bacterial DNA gyrase. Fluoroquinolones inhibit bacterial DNA gyrase and topoisomerase IV, disrupting DNA replication. Reference: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK547713/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
